ModMetaData.name: PollutionArmory[Continued]
ModMetaData.author: https://steamcommunity.com/id/yzywd
ModMetaData.description:
PollutionArmory[Continued] is a RimWorld 1.6 continuation of POP's Pollution weapon[Abandoned].
Continuation changes: - Ported the mod to RimWorld 1.6 and rebuilt the former 1.5-only assembly against the current API. - Added explicit Biotech dependency and a 1.6 load-folder mapping. - Preserved the original defNames and packageId for save compatibility. - Base-game weapon balance and gameplay values remain unchanged; CE uses separate compatibility values for its ballistic model. - Includes optional Combat Extended (CE) 1.6 compatibility, with dedicated ammunition, CE ballistics, and CE-compatible ballistic handling for weapon abilities. When CE is enabled, load it before this mod; CE is not bundled with this mod.
Original author: 顶针的马 / POP (https://steamcommunity.com/id/yzywd) Original mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3276521515 This is an independently maintained continuation, released with permission from the original author. Source repository: https://github.com/Juggernautsst/PollutionArmory-Continued Requires Biotech. Do not enable this together with the original mod.
PollutionArmory[Continued] 是 POP 原作《Pollution weapon[Abandoned]》的 RimWorld 1.6 续作。
续作改动： - 已适配 RimWorld 1.6，并依据当前 API 重建原先仅支持 1.5 的程序集。 - 已声明 Biotech 依赖并新增 1.6 加载目录映射。 - 保留原有 defName 和 packageId，以兼容旧存档。 - 原版模式下未主动调整武器数值或玩法平衡；CE 因使用独立弹道模型而采用专用兼容数值。 - 已包含可选的 Combat Extended（CE）1.6 兼容，包括专属弹药、CE 弹道与武器能力的 CE 弹道处理。启用 CE 时，请将 CE 排在本 Mod 前；本 Mod 不附带 CE。
原作者：顶针的马 / POP（https://steamcommunity.com/id/yzywd） 原 Mod：https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3276521515 这是独立维护的续作，已获原作者许可发布。源码仓库：https://github.com/Juggernautsst/PollutionArmory-Continued 需要 Biotech。请勿与原 Mod 同时启用。
